cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Efficiency Win
cards.instruction: Celebrate each inconvenience as proof that a faster, cheaper, or smarter routine can now be invented.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The lift's broken! Finally, a use for the efficiency lessons I gave you. Cancel the gym; the stairs are included in our rent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you counted the repetitions. A complete workout on the way home—no separate trip.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What about carrying all the shopping?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent, you've added weights. Milk in one bag, tins in the other. Remember how I taught you to balance a load? We can stop paying to lift things now.
